replication_rule: same gateway/tag/acquisition timestamp identity and exact acquired current per channel
quorum: strictly more than two thirds equal-power participants; three of four
validated_value: copy agreed observation; no averaging or engineering conversion
advisory_index: 1/(1 + mean absolute pair distance in mA divided by 16); software diagnostic, no acceptance role
comparison: same-event digital projections, zero mA tolerance by default
engineering_fields_role: raw HART metadata or configured SCADA display only
edge_derived_physics_metrics: not generated; optional historic field only
model_input: acquired currents and recorded diagnostic flags; contextual model uses four physical and four supervisory currents
future_independent_adc_path: requires selected hardware, acquisition uncertainty and timing specification; not implied by exact digital copy equality
